description: This PHP source file defines the class DocumentPopupPicker used in SuiteCRM to filter documents in a popup window for composing emails. It extends the Popup_Picker class and provides a method to generate SQL WHERE clauses based on request parameters.

classes.name: DocumentPopupPicker
classes.description: A class for filtering documents in an email compose popup in SuiteCRM, extending the basic popup picker functionality.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Generates an SQL WHERE clause for filtering documents based on request parameters.
